title: Server administration
description: The accounts on this server, their sessions and their passwords. You see this page because your verified email address is listed in ADMIN_EMAILS.

workspaces.heading: Workspace creation
workspaces.description: Set with WORKSPACE_CREATION on the server (everyone or admins). Everyone still gets a personal workspace when they sign up.

sessions.heading: Everyone
sessions.description: {count, plural, one {# signed-in session} other {# signed-in sessions}} on this server.
sessions.signOutEveryoneDescription: Ends every session on every device except yours in this browser, and pages open there stop syncing. Connected apps and API tokens keep working.
sessions.signOutEveryoneBody: Everyone on this server has to sign in again, you too on your other devices.
sessions.resetEveryoneDescription: Everyone who signs in with a password, except you, is signed out and has to choose a new password at their next sign-in. Accounts that only sign in with single sign-on, GitHub or Google aren't affected.
sessions.resetByEmail: When they sign in, they get a link by email to choose it.
sessions.resetInApp: Email isn't set up on this server, so they choose it right after signing in with their old password (and a two-step code, if they use one).
sessions.resetEveryoneBody: Everyone with a password, except you, is signed out now and can't sign in with their current password again.

users.heading: Accounts
users.countPartial: Showing {shown} of {total} accounts. Search to find the others.
users.signOutBody: {count, plural, one {Their # session ends} other {Their # sessions end}}, and pages they have open stop syncing. Connected apps and API tokens keep working.
users.signOutSelfBody: {count, plural, one {Your # session ends} other {Your # sessions end}}, except the one in this browser.
users.resetBody: They are signed out now and have to choose a new password the next time they sign in with one.
users.resetByEmail: When they sign in, they get a link by email to choose it.
users.resetInApp: Email isn't set up on this server, so they choose it right after signing in with their old password (and a two-step code, if they use one).

errors.noPassword: This account has no password; it signs in another way.
errors.self: Change your own password on your account page.

descriptionFirstAccount: The accounts on this server, their sessions and their passwords. You see this page because yours was the first account on this server.

signUp.heading: Sign-up
signUp.openDescription: Anyone who can open this server's address can create an account. To close sign-up, set DISABLE_SIGNUP=true on the server (with Docker, in the .env file next to docker-compose.yml, then run docker compose up -d). Existing accounts can still sign in, and people you invite can still join.
signUp.closedDescription: Set with DISABLE_SIGNUP on the server. Existing accounts can still sign in, and people you invite can still join through their invitation link.

firstAdmin.title: You administer this server
firstAdmin.body: Yours is the first account here, so Server administration is yours. Anyone who can reach this address can still sign up; Server administration shows how to close it.

networks.heading: Approved networks
networks.description: Workspaces that only open from approved networks. If a list shuts a workspace's owners out, clear it here: the workspace then opens from any network until its owners set the list again.
networks.none: No workspace limits sign-in to approved networks
networks.noneDescription: Owners set approved networks in their workspace's Settings → Security.
networks.clearBody: Everyone in the workspace can open it from any network again, and its audit log records that you cleared the list. Its owners can set it again in Settings → Security.
